name: Background Process Manager
description: Spawn, monitor, stop, and remove long-running external processes (e.g. Python servers, Node scripts, shell daemons) as persistent background tasks. Use 'spawn' to start a detached process, 'list' to see all, 'logs' to tail output, 'stop' to terminate, and 'remove' to clean up.

action.description: Action to perform: spawn=start new process, list=show all processes, stop=send SIGTERM, remove=delete exited process from registry, logs=tail stdout/stderr

command.description: Executable to run, e.g. 'python3', 'node', 'bash'. Required for 'spawn'.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the command, e.g. ['server.py', '--port', '9000']. Optional for 'spawn'.

label.description: Human-friendly name for the process (optional, defaults to command).

cwd.description: Working directory for the spawned process. Optional, defaults to Yui's root.

env.description: Extra environment variables to set for the process. Optional.

id.description: Process ID returned from 'spawn'. Required for 'stop', 'remove', and 'logs'.

signal.description: OS signal to send when stopping, e.g. 'SIGTERM' (default) or 'SIGKILL'.

tail.description: Number of log lines to return for 'logs' action. Default 100.
